senses.gloss:
खेल् खेल्, cl. 1. P. खेलति, &c., to shake,
move to and fro, swing; to tremble:
Caus. खेलयति, -यितुम्, to cause to move to and
fro, to swing, shake.

खेल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, shaking, trembling,
swinging; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f. sport, play.
—खेल-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, or खेल-गमन, अस्, आ,
अम्, having a stately walk.
—खेल-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
stately going.

खेलन, अम्, n. shaking; quivering motion (of
the eyes); play, pastime, sport; (ई), f. a piece or
man at drafts, chess, &c.

खेलाय, nom. P. खेलायति, -यितुम्, to play,
sport.

खेलि, इस्, f. play, sport; an animal; a bird; the
sun; an arrow; a song, a hymn.

खेलुद खेलुद, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a
particular high number; [cf. कलहु.]
